title: Open an invoice from the phone — and send it or take payment there
body: Invoice rows in Collections on the phone used to be dead taps. Now tapping one in AR aging, Invoices or Payments opens the invoice: who's billed, the line items, what's been collected and what's still owed — with Send to customer and Record payment right there. Recording a payment is now safe to retry on a bad signal: if the phone never hears back whether the first tap saved, the next one checks before it writes, so the same payment can't be posted twice.
